data.name: Apococlicks
data.detailed_description:
Humanity survived the end of the world… but only just. Buried beneath the ruins lies a forgotten research facility, sealed shut in the final hours before the collapse. Now, decades later, you are the first to break through its rusted doors.

What you find inside is more than dust and silence.

This is a post‑apocalyptic clicker adventure where every action uncovers another fragment of the past — and another tool to shape the future. Scavenge abandoned labs, restore ancient machinery, and decode encrypted logs left behind by the scientists who once worked here. Their experiments weren’t just ambitious. They were dangerous. And the deeper you go, the clearer their intentions become.

But you’re not alone down here. Above ground, the remnants of civilisation struggle to rebuild. As you gather resources, you can send food, data, and recovered knowledge back to the surface, helping the survivors grow stronger, smarter, and more hopeful. Their progress unlocks new opportunities for you in return, creating a cycle of mutual survival.

Every click pushes you further into the unknown.
Every discovery reshapes the world.
Every choice determines what rises from the ashes.

Uncover the truth. Rebuild the future.
And decide whether the past should stay buried.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel i5‑8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD RX 580 (8GB)
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel i7‑9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / 3060 or AMD RX 5700 XT
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
